tasks.label: deploy: pull and up on servarr
tasks.detail: git pull the pushed compose config on servarr and apply it with docker compose up -d
args: cd ~/servarr && git pull --ff-only && docker compose up -d --remove-orphans

tasks.label: restart: one service on servarr
tasks.detail: docker compose restart a service (gluetun also restarts qbittorrent, which shares its network)
args: cd ~/servarr && docker compose restart ${input:service} && docker compose ps

tasks.label: abook: queue abook.link post
tasks.detail: Look up an abook.link code on NZBKing and queue it in SABnzbd (runs scripts/abook on servarr)

inputs.description: Code from the post, as shown (e.g. abook.link - f5135574dfc3a2f5a7ee)
Name, e.g. Author - Title (optional; empty uses the code)
